emails.subject: Spring intern cohort — onboarding workshop schedule
emails.body:
Hi managers,

Quick reminder that the Spring intern cohort (including Alex Chen and Priya Nair on your team) has the new-hire onboarding workshop block running every Monday and Wednesday from 14:35 PT on the 6th floor through end of May. Please plan team meetings around their hard-stop at 14:35 on those days.

— Northstar People Ops

emails.subject: Save the date — NorthstarConf 2026 (Oct 14–16, SF)
emails.body:
Team,

Quick announcement before next week's all-hands: we're locking in NorthstarConf 2026 for October 14–16 in San Francisco. Same venue as last year. Each engineering team will have keynote and breakout slots — managers will be in touch with their teams about topic submissions. CFP deadline is June 1. More at the all-hands.

— Bob

emails.subject: Re: Thursday 1:1 agenda
emails.body:
Hey Maya — for Thursday, I want to talk through the May on-call rotation week-4 situation (data infra hasn't replied) and walk through the gateway-cutover risk register. 30 min should be enough.

Also happy to brainstorm anything you want to think through before the team sync on Tuesday.

— D.

emails.subject: Pairing time with Priya — conference breakout
emails.body:
Hey Maya — if you do want Priya as a co-presenter on a metrics-pipeline breakout for NorthstarConf, happy to take that on. She's done the bulk of the implementation and would be a strong co-presenter. Let me know if you want me to loop her in.

— Sarah

emails.subject: Q3 priorities — observability case
emails.body:
Hey Maya — heads-up that I'll probably push for observability rewrite over multi-region in Tuesday's sync. The Apr 18 incident took as long as it did almost entirely because we couldn't see what was happening. Wanted to flag in advance so it's not a surprise.

— Marcus

emails.subject: Re: May on-call coverage — week 4
emails.body:
Hi Maya, Diana — yes, we can cover Platform's week 4 in May. In exchange we'd like Platform to cover one of our weeks in July (Marcus's vacation week works for us if it works for you). Easy swap. Loop me in once it's posted.

— Anand
